Address in the JSON-LD block ("1759 Oceanside Blvd") matches the work list exactly. 84 items grouped by their real subsectionUuid into 16 categories (Uber Eats left the subsection NAMES empty - 'subsectionsMap':{} - so category labels below are inferred from what's actually in each group, e.g. the group priced flat at $5.85 across Carne Asada/Carnitas/Chorizo/Ham and Cheese/Machaca/Torta al Caribe is clearly Tortas). Several protein names (Carne Asada, Carnitas, Chicken, Pollo Asado) repeat across Tacos/Tortas/Burritos/Plates/A la Carte/Tostadas at different prices - ran the subtraction test on this scatter before trusting it: within each subsection the prices cluster tightly (Tortas flat $5.85, Plates flat $8.99, Combo Plates flat $7.99) and differ only BETWEEN formats (taco vs torta vs burrito vs plate), which fully explains the cent scatter as real format-based pricing rather than a fee - no divisor (1.04-1.30) landed more than 17% of items on round/.95/.99 values. Excluded nothing as adjunct; 'Sides & Add-ons' (guacamole, fries, onions, etc. $0.70-$2.00) are individually priced on the storefront so kept as their own rows.

name: Chiba Japanese
notes: First-party PDF linked from the restaurant's own /menu.html (not the separate dated 2019 PNG also on the homepage). Address confirmed via the site's embedded Google Maps link ("10435 San Diego Mission Rd, San Diego, CA 92108"), matching the work list. pdftotext -layout paired names to prices cleanly for most sections (cents are conventional: only $.25/.50/.75/.95 appear, no markup scatter), but this is a large-format (11.67x18.67in) poster PDF with a multi-column layout, and -layout mis-merged columns in several sections so badly that -raw confirmed names and prices land in separate blocks with no reliable line-level correspondence there. Rather than guess, I DROPPED the following as unpairable: the Combination Bento column (Lunch Bento/Chiba Bento/Special Chiba Bento/Special Chiba Combo), the Meat Platters column (Chicken/Beef/Pork/Chicken Katsu/Ton Katsu/Curry/Katsu Curry plates), the entire Seafood Platter section (Seafood Teriyaki, Salmon Teriyaki, Fried Seafood Mix, Fried Salmon, Fried Jumbo Shrimp, Tempura Shrimp, Shrimp Teriyaki - no prices found at all), Oyako Don (two conflicting prices, $12.95 and $13.95, appeared for it - true disagreement, not filed), Chicken/Beef/Vegetable Sukiyaki and Vegetable Rice Bowl (name with no same-line price), Chiba Stamina Noodles/Katsu Curry Noodles/Chiba Noodle (no price found), Ramune and Mogu Fruit Juice (flavors only, no price), Hamachi Kama/Salmon Kama (priced 'Seasonal', not a number), an unnamed nigiri description ('tuna wrapped around a rice ball...' $7.50, no item name survived the layout merge), Shrimp Ball and Volcano nigiri creations (named, no price found), and the entire Beer section (Kirin Ichiban/Kirin Light/Asahi/Sapporo/Sapporo Light/Heineken/Corona/Bud Light - prices visibly off-by-one-row against the names). Kept Mochi Ice Cream ($4.50) despite the price sitting on the 'Desserts' header line above it, since it is the section's only item and only nearby price. This is a partial: Appetizers, Nigiri, Nigiri Platters, Sashimi, Hand Rolls, Regular Rolls, Maki Rolls, and Special Rolls are complete; Entrees/Rice Bowl is reduced to 4 items (Chicken, Beef, Pork, Katsu Don) plus a 1-item Noodles section, and Bento Combos, Seafood Platters, and Beer are entirely missing.
